scopes.port: Ported to Rust with API and test parity against the pinned OCCT revision.
scopes.replaced: Not ported; a new Rust design replaces it (user decision).
scopes.undecided: Not part of the library API; the user has not decided the scope yet.

decisions.reason: Do not port OCCT OpenGL visualization; write a new Vulkan renderer on the ../Oblikovati renderer patterns.
OCCT native file formats are not ported; only exchange formats (STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, glTF, VRML, PLY, DE) are.
DRAW Tcl test-harness command toolkits; they expose commands, not library API.
